chapterInfo.content:
4
Euodia ne Sintike
1 # 2 Ko 1.14; 1 Te 2.19-20 Enti, me nuanom a medɔ mo na mefe mo, m’anigyeɛ ne m’abotire, monnyina pintinn wɔ Awurade mu saa, m’adɔfoɔ. 2Metu Euodia fo, na metu Sintike nso fo sɛ wɔnya adwene korɔ Awurade mu. 3#Luka 10.20 Na mesrɛ wo nso, me yɔnko konnuasoafoɔ nokwafoɔ, sɔ saa mmaa yi mu abia, ɛfiri sɛ wɔn na wɔkaa me ho peree asɛmpa no, wɔne Klemens nso ne me yɔnko adwumayɛfoɔ a aka a wɔn din hyehyɛ nkwa nwoma mu no.
Anigyeɛ, ahopakyire, ɔdwoɔ ne mpaebɔ
4 # Flp 3.1; 2 Ko 13.11 Momma mo ani nnye Awurade mu daa! Meka no bio sɛ: Momma mo ani nnye! 5Momma nnipa nyinaa nhunu mo abodwokyerɛ! Awurade abɛn. 6#Mat 6.25-34; 1 Pe 5.7; Dwom 145.18 Monnna nnnwene biribiara nnha mo ho, na mmom ade nyinaa mu momfa mpaebɔ ne nkotosrɛ ɛne aseda mma mo adesrɛ nnuru Nyankopɔn aso mu; 7#Yoh 14.27; Kol 3.15 na Nyankopɔn asomdwoeɛ a ɛtra nteaseɛ nyinaa soɔ no bɛhwɛ mo akoma ne mo adwene so Kristo Yesu mu.
Adwempa ne asetena pa
8 # Rom 12.17 Afei deɛ ɛdi akyire, anuanom, deɛ ɛyɛ nokorɛ, deɛ anim yɛ duro, deɛ ɛtene, deɛ ɛho teɛ, deɛ ɛyɛ ahomeka, deɛ ɛwɔ din pa, sɛ ɔbra pa bi wɔ hɔ a, sɛ ayeyie bi wɔ hɔ a, saa nnoɔma yi ho na monnwene; 9#1 Te 5.23 deɛ moasua nso na moagyeɛ na moateɛ na moahunu wɔ me ho no, ɛno ara na monyɛ! Na asomdwoeɛ Nyankopɔn ne mo bɛtena.
Aseda
10Nso m’ani gye kɛseɛ wɔ Awurade mu sɛ moafiri aseɛ redwene me ho bio; modwene me ho deɛ, nanso moannya ho kwan. 11#1 Ti 6.6 Ɛnyɛ sɛ ohia nti na mereka yei; ɛfiri sɛ me deɛ, masua sɛ asetena biara a mewɔ mu no, mepene ma no dɔɔso ma me.
12 # 2 Ko 6.10 Menim ahokyere, na menim ahonya nso. Biribiara ne nnoɔma nyinaa akokwa me, ɔmeeɛ ne ɛkɔm ne akonkosɛm ne hiadie; 13#2 Ko 12.10 metumi ade nyinaa yɛ, deɛ ɔhyɛ me den no mu.
14Nanso moyɛɛ no yie sɛ moboaa me wɔ m’ahohia no mu. 15#2 Ko 11.9 Na mo Filipifoɔ nso monim sɛ asɛmpa no mfitiaseɛ mu a mefiri Makedonia mekɔeɛ no, asafo biara ammoa me ɔma ne ɔgyeɛ nkontabuo ho, sɛ mo nko ara. 16Na Tesalonika nso mosomaa prɛko ne ne mprenu so de deɛ ɛhia me brɛɛ me. 17#1 Ko 9.11 Ɛnyɛ sɛ merehwehwɛ akyɛdeɛ, na mmom merehwehwɛ aba a ɛma mo nkonta dɔɔso. 18#Flp 2.25 Na manya ne nyinaa ama no aboro so. Na ɛfiri sɛ me nsa kaa deɛ mode manee Epafrodito no, mayɛ ma, ɛyɛ ehwa a ɛyɛ dɛ, ɛyɛ afɔrebɔ a wɔgye a ɛsɔ Nyankopɔn ani. 19Na me Nyankopɔn bɛma mo deɛ ɛhia mo nyinaa, sɛdeɛ n’ahonya no teɛ, animuonyam mu, Kristo Yesu mu. 20Yɛn Agya Nyankopɔn na wɔmfa animuonyam mma no daa daa. Amen.
Nkradie
21Monkyeakyea ahotefoɔ no nyinaa mmaako mmaako Kristo Yesu mu. Anuanom a wɔka me ho no kyeakyea mo. 22Ahotefoɔ no nyinaa kyeakyea mo, ne titire no, wɔn a wɔfiri Kaesare fie.
23Awurade Yesu Kristo adom nka mo honhom.

pageProps.chapterText:
Enti, me nuanom a medɔ mo na mefe mo, m’anigyeɛ ne m’abotire, monnyina pintinn wɔ Awurade mu saa, m’adɔfoɔ. Metu Euodia fo, na metu Sintike nso fo sɛ wɔnya adwene korɔ Awurade mu. Na mesrɛ wo nso, me yɔnko konnuasoafoɔ nokwafoɔ, sɔ saa mmaa yi mu abia, ɛfiri sɛ wɔn na wɔkaa me ho peree asɛmpa no, wɔne Klemens nso ne me yɔnko adwumayɛfoɔ a aka a wɔn din hyehyɛ nkwa nwoma mu no.

Momma mo ani nnye Awurade mu daa! Meka no bio sɛ: Momma mo ani nnye! Momma nnipa nyinaa nhunu mo abodwokyerɛ! Awurade abɛn. Monnna nnnwene biribiara nnha mo ho, na mmom ade nyinaa mu momfa mpaebɔ ne nkotosrɛ ɛne aseda mma mo adesrɛ nnuru Nyankopɔn aso mu; na Nyankopɔn asomdwoeɛ a ɛtra nteaseɛ nyinaa soɔ no bɛhwɛ mo akoma ne mo adwene so Kristo Yesu mu.

Afei deɛ ɛdi akyire, anuanom, deɛ ɛyɛ nokorɛ, deɛ anim yɛ duro, deɛ ɛtene, deɛ ɛho teɛ, deɛ ɛyɛ ahomeka, deɛ ɛwɔ din pa, sɛ ɔbra pa bi wɔ hɔ a, sɛ ayeyie bi wɔ hɔ a, saa nnoɔma yi ho na monnwene; deɛ moasua nso na moagyeɛ na moateɛ na moahunu wɔ me ho no, ɛno ara na monyɛ! Na asomdwoeɛ Nyankopɔn ne mo bɛtena.

Nso m’ani gye kɛseɛ wɔ Awurade mu sɛ moafiri aseɛ redwene me ho bio; modwene me ho deɛ, nanso moannya ho kwan. Ɛnyɛ sɛ ohia nti na mereka yei; ɛfiri sɛ me deɛ, masua sɛ asetena biara a mewɔ mu no, mepene ma no dɔɔso ma me.
Menim ahokyere, na menim ahonya nso. Biribiara ne nnoɔma nyinaa akokwa me, ɔmeeɛ ne ɛkɔm ne akonkosɛm ne hiadie; metumi ade nyinaa yɛ, deɛ ɔhyɛ me den no mu.
Nanso moyɛɛ no yie sɛ moboaa me wɔ m’ahohia no mu. Na mo Filipifoɔ nso monim sɛ asɛmpa no mfitiaseɛ mu a mefiri Makedonia mekɔeɛ no, asafo biara ammoa me ɔma ne ɔgyeɛ nkontabuo ho, sɛ mo nko ara. Na Tesalonika nso mosomaa prɛko ne ne mprenu so de deɛ ɛhia me brɛɛ me. Ɛnyɛ sɛ merehwehwɛ akyɛdeɛ, na mmom merehwehwɛ aba a ɛma mo nkonta dɔɔso. Na manya ne nyinaa ama no aboro so. Na ɛfiri sɛ me nsa kaa deɛ mode manee Epafrodito no, mayɛ ma, ɛyɛ ehwa a ɛyɛ dɛ, ɛyɛ afɔrebɔ a wɔgye a ɛsɔ Nyankopɔn ani. Na me Nyankopɔn bɛma mo deɛ ɛhia mo nyinaa, sɛdeɛ n’ahonya no teɛ, animuonyam mu, Kristo Yesu mu. Yɛn Agya Nyankopɔn na wɔmfa animuonyam mma no daa daa. Amen.

Monkyeakyea ahotefoɔ no nyinaa mmaako mmaako Kristo Yesu mu. Anuanom a wɔka me ho no kyeakyea mo. Ahotefoɔ no nyinaa kyeakyea mo, ne titire no, wɔn a wɔfiri Kaesare fie.
Awurade Yesu Kristo adom nka mo honhom.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
